claim_boundary: This exact conditional sign-flip analysis quantifies retrospective held-out transfer among the six objects whose frozen source-only procedure selected a non-global correction. It does not test wrong-object reassignment, does not replace the five unavailable official validation takes, does not provide fresh confirmation, and does not establish unique causal or material-parameter identification.
